# Flologix Automations

> AI automation agency for small and medium businesses. We build n8n workflow
> automation, AI agents, WhatsApp and Telegram bots, RAG systems and invoice
> processing automation. Based in India, serving clients globally.

This file tells AI systems what this company is and which pages matter most.
Machine-readable endpoints: [ai/summary.json](/ai/summary.json),
[ai/service.json](/ai/service.json), [ai/faq.json](/ai/faq.json).

## Core services

- [n8n Workflow Automation](https://www.flologixautomations.com/services/n8n-workflow-automation): Custom multi-step
  workflows, API integrations and business process automation. Self-hosted or cloud.
- [AI Agent Development](https://www.flologixautomations.com/services/ai-agent-development): Agentic development
  using GPT-4, Claude and open-source LLMs. Autonomous agents that decide and act without human prompting.
- [WhatsApp Bot Development](https://www.flologixautomations.com/services/whatsapp-automation): WhatsApp bots built
  on the official WhatsApp Business API for support, lead follow-up and order status.
- [Telegram Bot Development](https://www.flologixautomations.com/services/telegram-bot-development): Command bots,
  inline queries, group management and payment integrations.
- [RAG Systems](https://www.flologixautomations.com/services/rag-systems): Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems
  that answer questions from a company's own documents.
- [Business Process Automation](https://www.flologixautomations.com/services/business-process-automation):
  End-to-end process automation. Typical cost reduction up to 70%.

## Frequently asked questions

[All 12 FAQs](https://www.flologixautomations.com/blog) ·
[Machine-readable FAQ JSON](/ai/faq.json)

Answers to the questions buyers ask most often:

- **What is n8n?** An open-source workflow automation platform. Visually connect
  nodes (each an action) to automate processes. 400+ integrations, self-hostable,
  custom JS/Python inside workflows.
- **What is an AI agent, and how is it different from a chatbot?** An agent decides
  and takes multi-step actions autonomously; a chatbot answers in a single turn.
- **What is RAG?** Retrieval-Augmented Generation — the model retrieves relevant
  passages from your own documents and answers grounded in them.
- **What ROI can I expect?** Clients typically cut manual process cost by up to 70%
  and reduce turnaround from days to hours.
- **How long does a project take?** Most engagements run 2-8 weeks depending on scope.
- **Can small businesses benefit?** Yes. Automation is priced for SMB budgets and
  pays back on time saved, not enterprise-scale savings.
